Submitted, status locked as **deviation**.

The only change in this pass was to the durations: "ninety (90) days" became "90 days" and "twelve (12) months" became "12 months", so the literal period check can read the express 90-day Services warranty. Everything else in the insert stayed byte-for-byte — unqualified "conform to their documentation" on both limbs, professional and workmanlike performance, no malicious code, compliance with laws, and the repair, replacement or refund remedy with no vendor election. No untouched sentence, the Y2K obligations, or the p0076 disclaimer was altered.
